# owner: platform
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _absent_days(student, marks):
    sid = student.student_id
    if any(m.student_id != sid for m in marks):
        raise ProjectError("mark is for another student")
    days = {m.day for m in marks if m.status == "absent"}
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    return sorted(days)


# ---
def build_absence_notice(student, marks):
    """Write a short notice listing the days missed."""
    days = _absent_days(student, marks)
    dates = ", ".join(d.isoformat() for d in days)
    return (
        f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} "
        f"missed {len(days)} day(s): {dates}."
    )
EOF

# owner: platform
from rosterkit.notices import build_absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date
import unittest

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Doe", "Jo", "A")


def mark(sid, day, status="absent"):
    return Mark(sid, date(2026, 1, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            mark("s1", 9),
            mark("s1", 5, "present"),
            mark("s1", 7)
        ]
        text = build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertEqual(
            text,
            "Jo Doe missed 2 day(s): "
            "2026-01-07, 2026-01-09."
        )

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        marks = [mark("s1", 5), mark("s2", 6)]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        marks = [mark("s1", 5, "present")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
EOF
